research_scope: Current Xenoverse 2 mechanics enrichment for five previously thin Fighting Pose Super records.

records.name: Fighting Pose B
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence identifies Fighting Pose B as a 0-Ki Power Up Super that temporarily boosts Strike moves for 20 seconds. The current reference places it at PQ16 — Defeat Frieza's Army! and lists Jeice and Captain Ginyu Customize Partner as users. Exact damage multiplier and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose D
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence identifies Fighting Pose D as a 0-Ki Power Up Super that increases Boost Dash speed for 20 seconds. The current reference places it at PQ15 — Gotta Find That Dragon Ball! and lists Burter and Captain Ginyu Customize Partner as users. Exact speed multiplier and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose G
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence identifies Fighting Pose G as a Power Up Super using 0 Ki. It raises Ki Blast skill damage; the cited reference reports about 8% increased output, with the buff lasting 25 seconds for Male Saiyans and 20 seconds for Female Saiyans and other races. Exact frame data and patch-independent balance values remain outside scope.

records.name: Fighting Pose I
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence identifies Fighting Pose I as a 0-Ki Power Up Super that increases Basic Movement Speed for 20 seconds. Skill Shop access follows completion of The Ginyu Force Strikes. Exact movement multiplier, frame data, and patch-independent balance values remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose J
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence identifies Fighting Pose J as a 0-Ki Power Up Super associated with Recoome and intended to strengthen Strike-oriented offense. The repository preserves exact duration/magnitude as source-bounded until the dedicated current reference is reconciled; no unsupported numerical multiplier is promoted.

verification_audit.method: Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill references were checked for classification, Ki cost, core effect, duration where explicitly stated, and acquisition context. Unsupported multipliers, frame data, reward probabilities, hidden prerequisites, and patch-independent balance claims were not inferred.
verification_audit.evidence_limits: Research-layer promotion only. Existing canonical acquisition relationships and unresolved fields remain unchanged until canonical/index synchronization is performed.
